stemMd: If f(x) = 2x − 1 and g(x) = x², what is g(f(3))?
explanationMd: Evaluate from the inside outward: f(3) = 2 × 3 − 1 = 5. Then g(5) = 5² = 25. Reversing the composition gives a different result, so keep the nesting order explicit.

distractorRationale.c: This computes f(g(3)) instead of g(f(3)).
distractorRationale.a: This stops after evaluating the inner function.
distractorRationale.e: This ignores the subtraction in f before squaring.
distractorRationale.b: This does not apply either composition in the stated order.
